summary: At segment 0 step 73, JavaScript refuses the locked floor chest with autounlock:force. C pickup.c:do_loot_cont() queues lock.c:doforce() when this is the only container, the force flag is set, no earlier unlock spent a turn, and the hero has a forceable weapon; it then sets abort_looting.

source.branch: For a locked floor container, when AUTOUNLOCK_FORCE is active, the current result is not ECMD_TIME, ccount is one, and u_have_forceable_weapon() is true, do_loot_cont() queues doforce() and sets ga.abort_looting.
callers: pickup.c:doloot() reaches do_loot_cont() through doloot_core() for a single selected floor container (2279).
js/pickup.js:doloot_core() awaits do_loot_cont() in its single-container path (3622). The command loop dispatches the queued extcmd after #loot returns.

evidence: The admitted v66 evaluation at 979a3f3967638748dc19cf8b6ea8851736ade63e reports 73/136 screens, 2721/2810 RNG calls, and 73/136 cursors matched; its first stop is the unsupported autounlock-force branch at step 73. Manifest digest: 4cb5635d3288024bb20bcec606b739b01242610f3342409d90110a6dd390378c; recording digest: b0aa6eb91f646886e97ae527a0fa2f99b9b29a9d2c92b41f2e1456580e212072.

Fresh scan at e85cdcd0a89b8ab955a472334fa0f804f3280a99, wrapper run run-lH0de2, stops after “Hmmm, the chest turns out to be locked.” at the UnsupportedPickupError in js/pickup.js:do_loot_cont(). Saved scan: .cache/a2-v66-autoforce-scan.json.

Upstream pickup.c:do_loot_cont() (2112-2145) zeroes u.dz, attempts key/untrap first, then tests AUTOUNLOCK_FORCE, res != ECMD_TIME, ccount == 1, and u_have_forceable_weapon(); it calls cmdq_add_ec(CQ_CANNED, doforce) and sets ga.abort_looting. lock.c:u_have_forceable_weapon() (659-670) is already implemented as js/lock.js:u_have_forceable_weapon().

JavaScript already implements cmdq_add_ec() and ext_func_tab_from_func() in js/cmd.js and lock.js:doforce() is registered by the existing force extcmd. pickup.js currently throws UnsupportedPickupError for AUTOUNLOCK_FORCE without checking res or the wielded weapon, and does not queue doforce or set abort_looting.
